incident: CLI inherited connector startup emitted a Bitrix24 credential as a malformed environment-variable name; parent diagnostic displayed it before redaction
actions: Known exclusively owned diagnostic artifacts scrubbed; original secret not retained at those paths
Future internal CLI invocations must use --ignore-user-config and preserve auth normally
Operator informed and recommended revocation/reissue in connector configuration; no connector configuration or credential changed by agent
limit: Already-rendered tool output cannot be retracted; stderr snapshot replaced while CLI alive, so later original-fd output is not represented as retained evidence. Canonical product validation log is separate and unchanged.
